tpe_weekly_index.caption: Weekly TPE index range mid ((open+close)/2) published on The Plastics Exchange public chart API. This is not the same as the live offer mid shown as the current cost.

pla365_daily.caption: Daily China-market assessments compiled by pla365 from 生意社/100ppi.com.

bls_monthly.caption: Official monthly U.S. Producer Price Indexes from the BLS Public API. These are indexes, not dollars per pound.

sources.name: The Plastics Exchange
sources.cadence: Live U.S. spot offer range; updates as offers are posted (intraday, not a fixed clock). Weekly index history is also published on the public chart API.
sources.what: U.S. commodity PE/PP grades, USD/lb, current offer low–high (mid recorded as the cost).

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics PPI
sources.cadence: Monthly. New PPI figures are typically released around the 13th; values for the latest months may be marked preliminary.
sources.what: Official U.S. producer price indexes for plastic resins (not a dollars-per-pound quote). Series WPU066, WPU0662, PCU325211325211.

sources.name: 塑价365 / pla365.com (compiled from 生意社 / 100ppi.com)
sources.cadence: Daily China-market assessments (CSV dated by the publisher; often morning China time).
sources.what: China domestic prices in CNY per metric ton for HDPE, LDPE, LLDPE, PP raffia, PVC SG-5, GPPS (the 生意社 PS benchmark assessed on the GPPS 525 specification), PET, ABS. HIPS has no public daily grade quote in this feed.
sources.notes: Third-party public CSV that cites 100ppi.com as the underlying source. 100ppi.com itself returned a bot-challenge page and could not be fetched directly.

sources.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed) PCU325211325211
sources.cadence: Monthly redistributor of the BLS PPI series.
sources.what: Same official series as BLS PCU325211325211, as a CSV/graph download.
sources.notes: Human-verifiable in a browser. Scripted downloads from this environment timed out with 0 bytes, so the dashboard uses the BLS Public API for the same series.

sources.name: Plastics News resin prices
sources.cadence: Typically weekly contract prices (cents/lb) for subscribers.
sources.what: North American prime resin prices by grade and volume tier.
sources.notes: Scripted fetch returned HTTP 403 Access Denied. The price table is also a subscriber product. No free U.S. $/lb source was found for PET, PVC, GPPS, or HIPS.

sources.name: PlasticsToday resin pricing
sources.what: Industry news, not a structured public price table.
sources.notes: Scripted fetch returned a Cloudflare challenge (403).

sources.name: Plastics Technology monthly resin-pricing articles
sources.cadence: Monthly narrative (trajectory in cents/lb in some months).
sources.what: Qualitative price-trajectory articles for PE, PP, PS, PVC, PET. The November 2026 article discusses a flat-to-down path and does not publish a current cents/lb table in the public HTML.

sources.name: ChemAnalyst
sources.cadence: Monthly / quarterly assessments on public pages; live feed is a paid product.
sources.what: Regional USD/MT assessments (e.g. September 2026 USA LDPE). Too lagged for an hourly live board; not logged as a live reading.
sources.notes: A public page did contain September 2026 figures, which were already two months old as of this build. Not used in the live log.

sources.name: Procurement Resource
sources.what: Regional USD/MT averages (latest public table seen was August 2026).

sources.name: ChemOrbis price index
sources.what: PP, PE, PS, PVC, PET indexes.
sources.notes: Public HTML had no numeric index values without a login.

sources.name: IMARC polyethylene pricing report
sources.what: Market-size / sample report pages, not a current spot feed.

sources.name: 生意社 / 100ppi.com
sources.cadence: Daily China assessments (underlying source cited by pla365).
sources.notes: Returned a bot-challenge page. Values are taken from the pla365 public CSV that cites this source.

gaps: No free, scriptable U.S. dollars-per-pound source was found for PET, PVC, GPPS, or HIPS. The Plastics Exchange lists those styrenic grades only behind an account; its public offer board and chart API had no GPPS/HIPS numbers. BLS has no GPPS- or HIPS-specific PPI (WPU0662 is the aggregate thermoplastic-resins index, not polystyrene).

China GPPS is the pla365/生意社 PS benchmark, which pla365 states is assessed on the GPPS 525 specification, in CNY per metric ton. pla365 states HIPS has no public daily grade quote; SunSirs/100ppi pages that might carry grade detail returned a bot-challenge and could not be fetched from this environment. A HIPS price is never inferred from the GPPS/PS benchmark.
Plastics News, the usual North American contract-price table, is paywalled and blocked scripted access (HTTP 403).

UN Comtrade public preview data for HS 390319 (other polystyrene, GPPS and HIPS combined) can yield a monthly U.S. export unit value, but it is not grade-specific, is lagged, and the API is rate-limited, so it is not logged as a live board reading.
